name: Delhi Monsoon Open 2018
information:
Online Registration ends on 14th July and On the spot registration is available on 22 July from 8:00 to 9:00. Visit [registration and payments tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DelhiMonsoonOpen2018#6392-registration-and-payments) for details.
The main event for the competition is 2x2. 2x2 Winner will be declared the winner of Delhi Monsoon Open 2018.
